datasheet_id_and_revision: SBOS847B, July 2022, revised December 2024; package option addendum 8-Nov-2025; package materials 3-Sep-2026
datasheet_status: Production data (p1 footer 'PRODUCTION DATA'; addendum p24: OPA817DTKR Active, Production)
scope_of_this_file: headline specifications only (per coordinator); TIA application text not extracted
citation_convention: pN = 1-based PDF page index = printed page number for p1-p23. EC = Sec. 6.5 Electrical Characteristics (p5-p7), defaults: TA ~ 25 C, VS = +-5 V, G = 1 V/V (RF = 0), RF = 250 ohm for other gains, RL = 100 ohm, input/output referenced to mid-supply.
value_types: TYP, MIN/MAX (25 C unless over temperature), CURVE (PDF vector paths, axis calibration checked against grid lines), DERIVED (computed here)
compensation: unity-gain stable (p1, p3 comparison table: minimum stable gain 1 V/V)

supply.dual_or_single: total supply 6-12.6 V (split or single implied by 'referenced to mid-supply')
supply.recommended: 6 / 10 nom / 12.6 V (p4 Sec. 6.3); comparison table +-6.3 V; abs max dVS/dt 1 V/us for supply turn-on/off (p4)

overdrive_recovery.conditions: VOUT = VS- to VS+, G = 2 V/V

open_loop_curve.figure: Fig. 6-20 (p11) 'Open-Loop Gain Magnitude and Phase vs Frequency' (no simulation label visible); repeated as Fig. 7-5 (p16)
open_loop_curve.conditions: Sec. 6.6 defaults (+-5 V, RL = 100 ohm); load not annotated on the plot
open_loop_curve.phase_convention: phase of A_OL: ~-3 deg at 1 kHz, -90 deg plateau, -151 deg at 0.9 GHz (axis to -195 deg)

points.note: curve ends at 0.965 GHz (-4.1 dB, -155 deg)

open_loop_curve.crossings: 0 dB at 528 MHz with phase ~ -126 deg -> unity-gain phase margin ~54 deg (DERIVED); 6.02 dB (2 V/V) at 243 MHz; phase -120 deg at 448 MHz, -135 deg at 661 MHz
open_loop_curve.temperature: Fig. 7-6 (p16): A_OL magnitude at 1 kHz 97.7 / 87.7 / 78.1 dB for the three plotted temperatures (black/red/teal; legend not re-read), curves merge above ~1 MHz

spot.conditions: no frequency stated in the EC table

current_noise.curve_figure: Fig. 6-17 'Current Noise Density vs Frequency' (p10), 10 kHz-100 MHz, 1-10k fA/rtHz; no simulation label and no 'common-mode' annotation
current_noise.hf_behavior: rising proportional to f (slope 1.0) from ~20 kHz to ~30 MHz, then flattening to ~5-5.4 pA/rtHz between 60 and 100 MHz; not specified above 100 MHz
current_noise.how_measured_or_defined: not stated (no simulation label, no definition)
current_noise.derived_check: DERIVED: i_n / (en x 2 pi f) with en = 4.5 nV/rtHz = 3.86 pF at 1 MHz and 3.78 pF at 10 MHz, i.e. the rising part is consistent with en acting on a fixed ~3.8 pF (input capacitance C_CM + C_DIFF = 3.0 pF).

input_capacitance.definition_notes: EC p6: 'Input impedance common-mode 60 || 2.9 GOhm || pF'; 'Input capacitance differential mode 0.1 pF' (TYP)

input_common_mode_range.note: footnote: input range for CMRR > 77 dB

output_swing.type: over temp -40 to 85 C (3.2 / -3.2 V to 105 C)

output_swing_vs_load_curve.figure: Fig. 6-24 Output Voltage vs Output Current Over Temperature (p11), +-5 V; legend blue -40 C, cyan 25 C, black 85 C, red 105 C
output_swing_vs_load_curve.note: sinking (low side) collapses above ~60 mA at 25 C; at -40 C the low side holds -3.45 V to 70 mA

output_current.conditions: -40 to 85 C, dVOS < 3 mV (35 mA to 105 C)

packages.name: DTK (WSON-8; drawing DTK0008A, titled 'WQFN - 0.8 mm max height' on p27)
packages.ep_connection: p3: 'Electrically isolated from the die substrate. The thermal pad can be connected to any potential between the device power supplies. However, best practice is to connect the thermal pad to a heat-spreading plane, typically ground.'
packages.pinout: 1 PD, 2 FB, 3 IN-, 4 IN+, 5 VS-, 6 NC, 7 OUT, 8 VS+ (same as OPA818 DRG)
packages.orderables: OPA817DTKR (3000); MSL Level-2-260C-1 YEAR; marking 817; -40 to 105 C

pinout_notes: PD (pin 1): 'Low = amplifier disabled, High = amplifier enabled, internal 2-Mohm pullup allows floating' (p3); enable threshold max 4 V at +-5 V (specified on above VS+ - 1 V), disable threshold min 2 V (specified off below VS+ - 3 V); PD pin current 9 typ/12 max uA in shutdown, 0.5/1 uA active; turn-on 0.3 us, turn-off 0.1 us (p7). FB pin 2 internally connected to OUT, 0.7 ohm (p5).
abs_max_and_input_protection: p4: VS 13 V; dVS/dt 1 V/us; VI VS- to VS+; VID +-VS; II +-10 mA; IO +-30 mA; TJ 150 C; TA -40 to 105 C; Tstg -65 to 125 C; ESD HBM +-2000 V, CDM +-1500 V.
other_notes: Comparison table (p3): OPA817 +-6.3 V, 400 MHz, FET, 1000 V/us, 4.5 nV/rtHz, G >= 1; also lists OPA818, OPA657, OPA656, OPA659, OPA858, THS4631.
Closed-loop output impedance 0.04 ohm at 100 kHz (p6 EC).
inconsistencies_and_uncertainties: Input current noise 18 fA/rtHz (EC) has no frequency condition; on the Fig. 6-17 curve 18 fA/rtHz occurs near 165 kHz, while the curve reaches 0.11 pA/rtHz at 1 MHz and ~5 pA/rtHz near 100 MHz.
Package called WSON (p1, p3, p24, stencil p29) but the outline page p27 is titled 'WQFN - 0.8 mm max height, plastic quad flatpack - no lead' (same DTK0008A drawing).
Fig. 7-6 temperature legend not re-read; temperature assignment of the three A_OL curves left open.
